verificationMethod: Live network capture (HAR) of a real browser session on saudi.kfc.me/en/home
Live re-verification via a fresh Playwright session on 2026-08-05 (guestLogin, getAppConfig, getStoreList, getMenuConfig, getMenu, getHome, validateLocation, getNewStore all reconfirmed 200 OK live)

Static analysis of the site's own production JS bundles (endpoint path + HTTP method + payload-construction code read directly from the minified React bundle) as a first pass for getProductsByCategory and getProgressivePromotion specifically, to have a candidate payload shape to test

A full end-to-end live collector run (collector/collect.js --channel=PICKUP) against the fixed branch on 2026-08-05, which confirmed getProductsByCategory across all 12 real categories and getProgressivePromotion, and surfaced two corrections versus the bundle-based reconstruction (see each endpoint's verificationNote) plus the WAF header requirement (see notes)
notes: This file documents PUBLIC, unauthenticated (guest-session) endpoints only. No login, OTP, payment, or cart/checkout endpoint is used by this system.

'Session' fields (cookies, deviceid, authorization, refreshtoken) are captured fresh every run by collector/api-bootstrap.js and held in memory only for that process. They are NEVER written into this file, api-map.md, git, or any log.

Every endpoint below, INCLUDING getProductsByCategory and getProgressivePromotion, was live-verified end to end on 2026-08-05 with a real request/response pair against the fixed branch (Riyadh/SITEEN/storeId=251) under PICKUP - see each endpoint's verificationNote. The two endpoints initially reconstructed from the site's compiled JS bundle both required one correction versus the bundle's own optional-chaining code once tested live (see their verificationNote) - which is exactly why this system validates every response's shape at runtime instead of trusting any one source permanently.

The direct HTTPS calls made after the Playwright bootstrap must include browser-shaped `user-agent`, `origin`, and `referer` headers - the site's edge WAF (Azure Application Gateway) returns an HTML 403 page for requests missing them, even with an otherwise-valid session. These three values are not secret (every browser sends them in plain text) and are set as static defaults in collector/config.js.

Two things were explicitly NOT verified live and are documented as such rather than guessed: (1) Arabic content - locale='Ar' on getProductsByCategory returned HTTP 404, so product_name_ar/description_ar/category_name_ar are stored as NULL in v1; (2) a POPULATED getProgressivePromotion response - no progressive promotion was active on the branch at verification time, so only the empty-result shape is confirmed.
Do not assume this schema is permanently fixed. If a future run's schema-validation warnings persist, re-run the verification steps in this note's method and update lastVerificationDate.

Branch selection update (2026-08-06): the fixed branch was changed from SITEEN/storeId=251 to RABWAH/storeId=223 (still Riyadh). Reason: at this verification time SITEEN was closed for Pickup (getNewStore no longer resolved it as nearest - a normal operating-hours state, see channel-collector.js's verifyBranchExists note), so getStoreList's full Riyadh directory was queried and every store with services.tak=1 AND services.del=1 AND active=1 AND cmsStatus=1 was live-checked via getNewStore (Pickup) and validateLocation (Delivery); 8 of 98 Riyadh stores qualified (RABWAH/223, DAAERY/128, EUROMARCHE/143, HAMZA/165, SOLY/253, OM ELHAMAM/210, NOZHA/206, INDUSTRIAL/171). RABWAH/223 was confirmed end-to-end for both channels (getMenuConfig -> getMenu -> getProductsByCategory returned 12 categories and real priced products - e.g. "Double Up Deal" originalPrice=63/specialPrice=42 - identically on both PICKUP and DELIVERY) and selected. The endpoint shapes documented below are branch-independent and were not re-verified per-field against RABWAH (no schema change was expected or observed); the storeId/branchName values quoted in individual verificationNote entries below are historical (dated 2026-08-05, against SITEEN/251) and are left as-is rather than rewritten, since they describe what was literally observed at that time.

endpoints.name: guestLogin
endpoints.purpose: Bootstraps an anonymous guest session (deviceid + cart id). This is the site's own automatic behavior for every anonymous visitor - it happens on every page load regardless of any user action, requires no credentials, phone number, email, or OTP, and is not a real account login.

endpoints.name: getAppConfig
endpoints.purpose: Global app configuration, notably the blob-storage SAS token (blobBaseUrl.SASToken / .jsonBase) that several other endpoints require as their 'subPath' / 'path' payload fields.

endpoints.name: getStoreList
endpoints.purpose: Full city/branch directory for Saudi Arabia. Used every run to verify the configured branch (KFC_STORE_ID) still exists and is active before any other collection happens.
endpoints.channelDependency: none (directory covers all channels; per-store 'services' flags indicate which channels a given store supports)

endpoints.name: validateLocation
endpoints.purpose: Resolves DELIVERY serviceability + branch for a given lat/lng. Used once per DELIVERY run to (re)confirm the fixed branch is still the branch that serves the configured coordinates.

responseSchema.statusCode: 200 on success, 400/409 when the coordinates are not deliverable

endpoints.name: getNewStore
endpoints.purpose: Resolves the nearest PICKUP-capable branch for a given lat/lng (the 'USE MY LOCATION' action in the Self-Pickup branch picker). Used once per PICKUP run to (re)confirm the fixed branch is still the nearest branch to the configured coordinates.
endpoints.verificationNote: Discovered live (not previously documented anywhere) while bootstrapping the Self-Pickup flow for KFC_STORE_ID=251 - confirmed request payload {lat:24.6866,lng:46.724} -> response {cityId:11,areaId:8157,storeId:251}.

endpoints.name: getMenuConfig
endpoints.purpose: Given an order channel (and, for PICKUP, a resolved storeId), returns the menuConfigId + clusterId that scope every subsequent menu/category/product call to this exact branch+channel's live catalog.

requestPayload.storeId: number (required for PICKUP once a branch is resolved; omitted for DELIVERY, which resolves its store server-side from the session's validated address)

endpoints.channelDependency: PICKUP or DELIVERY (mutually exclusive per call - this is how the collector determines which channel a downstream getMenu/getProductsByCategory call belongs to, per the spec: 'the channel must be determined by the getMenuConfig flow that started the collection')
endpoints.branchDependency: PICKUP: explicit via storeId. DELIVERY: implicit via the session's last-validated address/store.

endpoints.name: getMenu
endpoints.purpose: Returns the full category tree (id, name_en/name_ar, productCount) for the menuConfigId resolved above. Category objects do NOT include their products - use getProductsByCategory per category id for that.

categories.id: number (category id - the primary key used by getProductsByCategory)
categories.name: string (category display name, English)

endpoints.channelDependency: inherited from the menuConfigId used to call it (spec: do not rely only on the 'service' field inside getMenu - the channel is whatever getMenuConfig flow produced this menuConfigId)
endpoints.branchDependency: inherited from the menuConfigId used to call it
endpoints.verificationNote: Live-confirmed: 12 categories returned for menuConfigId KFC_SA_76 / clusterId 14_5 (Exclusive, Baloot Limited Edition, New! Hot Honey, Matchday Boxes, Deal of the Day, Chicken Meals, Wraps, Burgers, Chicken Buckets, Sides, Dips, Drinks). Category objects do not carry name_ar in the payload actually observed (name_ar was expected but not present) - the normalizer treats it as optional and falls back to null, never guessing a translation.

endpoints.name: getProductsByCategory
endpoints.purpose: Returns every product in one category, including price, discount, promo id, bundle/build-step structure, and size/flavor variants. Called once per category id returned by getMenu - this is the main product/price/offer data source for the whole system.
endpoints.requestPayloadConfidence: LIVE-CONFIRMED on 2026-08-05 - this exact payload shape returned 200 with real product data for all 12 categories of the fixed branch (Riyadh/SITEEN/251) under PICKUP.

data.id: number (the category id requested - the response re-returns full category metadata, not just products)
data.name: string (category name, English - locale is fixed to 'En'; see localeNote)
data.promoId: number (0 when the category itself has no promo)

products.name: string (English name)
products.specialPrice: number, present only when an offer/discount is active. SENTINEL VALUE 0 (not absent) on ~28/106 sampled products - all build-your-own 'Combo'/'Box' bundle upsells that DO carry a real positive promoId but an EMPTY disPercentage; a genuine $0 price for a $19+ combo is not plausible, so this is 'not a simple fixed-discount price', not a free item. backend/normalizer.py's normalize_special_price() treats <=0 (and >=originalPrice) as 'no special price'.
products.disPercentage: string, e.g. '33% OFF', present only when an offer is active
products.promoId: number, SENTINEL VALUE -1 (not 0) when no offer is active - live-confirmed: 37/106 sampled products carried promoId=-1 with no discount, every product with a genuine active discount carried a distinct positive integer. backend/normalizer.py's normalize_promo_id() treats <=0 as 'no promo'.
products.categories: array of category ids this product belongs to
products.assets: array of { src: string (image URL), resolution, type }
products.variants: array of { id, title (e.g. 'Size'), options: [{ id, title (e.g. 'Regular'|'Medium'|'Large'), isSelected }] } - THIS is where size is identified with confidence; absent entirely for products with no size choice
products.steps: array of bundle build-steps: { id, title, subtitle, type ('radio'|'checkbox'|'stepper'), minimum, maximum, isAddon, isModifier, isDependent, ingredient, isHidden, compId }
products.subOptionStr: string, human-readable comma-joined summary of the bundle's default build (English) - e.g. 'Zinger Sandwich,Lettuce,...'
products.metaKeyword: array of string (often carries the human offer/bundle name, e.g. 'Double Up Deal')
products.nutrition_facts: array, EMPTY on every product sampled live - calories are NOT available from this endpoint, see calorieNote

endpoints.channelDependency: inherited from the menuConfigId/cluster/configId used to call it
endpoints.branchDependency: inherited from the menuConfigId/cluster/configId used to call it
endpoints.verificationNote: Live request/response pair captured for all 12 categories of the fixed branch under PICKUP. IMPORTANT CORRECTION vs. the bundle's own optional-chaining code: the response's `data` field IS the category object itself with `products` as a direct inline array (`response.data.products`) - NOT a further-nested `{data:{products}}` wrapper as the minified bundle's `u?.data?.data?.products` chain suggested (that chain is almost certainly unwrapping an axios response envelope one level higher up, before `u` is even this JSON body). collector/api-client.js and channel-collector.js both use the corrected single-nesting path.
endpoints.calorieNote: No calorie/kcal field was present on any of the ~120 products sampled live across all 12 categories (nutrition_facts was an empty array on every one). backend/normalizer.py stores `calories` as NULL rather than guessing - if a future response ever does carry it, the normalizer's defensive multi-key lookup (calories/kcal/energy) will pick it up automatically without a code change.
endpoints.localeNote: locale is fixed to 'En' for all collection - a live test of locale='Ar' on this endpoint returned HTTP 404 'Upstream returned 404', meaning Arabic content requires more than swapping this one field (likely a locale-specific menuConfigId/clusterId, based on getHome's groupId containing an 'En' segment that getMenuConfig's response does not expose a way to request). product_name_ar / description_ar / category_name_ar are therefore always stored as NULL in v1 - see api-map.md 'What was not verified'.

endpoints.name: getHome
endpoints.purpose: Homepage banner/deal-rail content. The collector calls this ONLY to read the numeric data.menuId field (not present anywhere in getMenu's response), which getProgressivePromotion's request payload needs. Not used for any product/price/offer data - collecting products always goes through getProductsByCategory.
endpoints.channelDependency: inherited from the menuConfigId/cluster used to call it
endpoints.branchDependency: inherited from the menuConfigId/cluster used to call it
endpoints.verificationNote: Live-confirmed request/response shape and presence of data.menuId. A failure here is logged and getProgressivePromotion is skipped for that run - it never fails the channel's crawl_runs status, since product/offer data comes from getProductsByCategory regardless.

endpoints.name: getProgressivePromotion
endpoints.purpose: Returns active progressive/tiered promotions for the current menu context (e.g. 'spend X get Y', multi-tier bundle deals not tied to one specific product/category). Called once per channel per run; results are matched to products by promoId.
endpoints.requestPayloadConfidence: LIVE-CONFIRMED on 2026-08-05 - returned HTTP 200 with this exact payload for the fixed branch under PICKUP (no progressive promotion was active at verification time, which is itself a valid, common response).

data.parentPromo: object, empty {} when no parent-level progressive promotion is active
data.promolist: object keyed by promoId (NOT an array) - empty {} when none are active; expected to map to promotion-detail objects when active

endpoints.branchDependency: inherited from the menuConfigId/cluster/configId used to call it
endpoints.verificationNote: Live request/response pair captured for the fixed branch under PICKUP: {"data":{"parentPromo":{},"promolist":{},"headerText":"Special offers for you"}}. CORRECTION vs. the initial reconstruction: `data` is an OBJECT with a `promolist` map keyed by promoId, not a bare array - collector/channel-collector.js extracts `Object.values(data.promolist)` defensively (falls back to [] for any other shape). The shape of a POPULATED promolist entry was not observed live (no progressive promotion was running for this branch at verification time) - backend/offer_parser.py treats this endpoint as supplementary only; the primary, always-required offer fields (specialPrice, promoId, disPercentage, limited_offer, subOptionStr) come from getProductsByCategory regardless of whether this endpoint returns anything.

notUsedButObservedLive.name: profile
notUsedButObservedLive.reason: Guest profile echo (device id, cart id). No product/price data.

notUsedButObservedLive.name: kfcloyalty/auth, kfcloyalty/loyalty-config, amr-loyalty/config
notUsedButObservedLive.reason: Walaa loyalty program surface - requires no data from us, we call none of it, it just fires automatically from the homepage. Out of scope: no login, no loyalty points.

schemaValidation.strategy: Every response is checked against the minimal shape it must have (HTTP 200, expected top-level keys present, expected array fields are arrays) before any data from it is used. See backend/schema_validator.py for the Python-side mirror used when validating a Node-collected snapshot before it is loaded into SQLite.
schemaValidation.onMismatch: Log the endpoint, HTTP status, and raw response body to data/raw/<run_id>/schema-errors.json; mark the affected category as failed; if any category in a channel run failed, that channel's crawl_runs row is PARTIAL (some categories collected) or FAILED (zero categories collected); PARTIAL/FAILED runs are excluded from change detection entirely (see backend/change_detector.py).
